Careers

Play a key role in the future of voice AI

Join our mission to deliver Verbit’s leading voice AI platform and technology solutions to thousands of legal, education, government, and media professionals worldwide.

Openings

ML/AI Engineer

We are seeking a skilled ML/AI Engineer to join our team and deliver cutting-edge ML/AI models in the ASR domain and legal insights more broadly. The core of this role is building, deploying, and serving ML models in production.

A key part of this role is speech engineering — prior ASR/speech experience is not a must, but a willingness to learn and grow into this domain is essential. Experience with LLM-based solutions and agentic flows is an advantage, not a requirement.

Our teams

Corporate

Verbit’s Corporate team is building a world-class global organization to support our company in its mission to make the world a more accessible and inclusive place.

Our corporate team leads and handles all of our business enablement functions. We’re always looking for industry thought leaders to join us as we aim to manage and grow all of our IT, finance, legal, M&A and BI teams.

Engineering

Our Engineering team is rapidly growing and prides itself on using the latest technology available, as well as developing our own. We are transforming the world’s most abundant resource—spoken language—into an asset that is accessible, insightful, and actionable across diverse environments, powered by a cutting-edge, AI-driven, interactive platform. We rely on our in-house data research team, which specializes in Automatic Speech Recognition and Natural Language Processing. Join us on our cloud-based journey to success, where we make sure to have fun along the way.

Marketing

Marketing teams are central to business success, and it’s no different at Verbit. Our marketing team thrives on collaboration and lives on data. We’re driving brand awareness and sales through exciting touchpoints of engagement. Be a key force in setting Verbit and its unique offerings apart with the creation of impactful content, campaigns, video, design, events, PR and much more.

Operations, Delivery, Support & Customer Success

The Operations team plays a vital role in supporting Verbit’s strategic objectives. While we continue to deliver high-quality transcripts and captions for millions of audio minutes each month, our focus has shifted to driving the company’s transformation towards automated solutions. Today, the team prioritizes customer onboarding, training, and support, as well as business process monitoring and innovation.

Our Customer Success group supports Verbit’s customers from Day 1 through their entire journey with us on both the business and technical sides. Our state-of-the-art onboarding and ongoing Customer Success team members are made up of industry experts who have domain knowledge.

Working at the core of Verbit, our team collaborates closely with leadership across Sales, Product, and R&D, offering an opportunity to make a significant impact in shaping the future of our industry.

People

We believe people are Verbit’s greatest superpower. That’s why we’re committed to hiring and supporting the growth of super powerful people. Our HR leadership is committed to putting people first. We’re creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where every person can bring the authentic version of themselves to work and feel comfortable each day. While Verbit is making the world accessible for everyone, join us as we fulfill a pledge to make our own workplace accessible and inclusive for everyone.

Product & Design

The Product & Design team is responsible for making Verbit’s dream a reality. Our team is built of creative thinkers. Our vision is a world in which all speech can be seamlessly converted into meaningful actions.

The team is responsible for managing Verbit’s product between all three disciplines (UX, technology and business). We accompany ideas from inception to maturity. Join us and work in a cloud-based, agile environment with some of the best in the industry.

Sales & Partnerships

Our sales, partnership and customer success team supports the customer acquisition activities for Verbit and drives new revenue opportunities to fuel our growth. Our mission is to develop our people, work for each other and deliver outstanding results to ensure the success of Verbit. Above all else, we are a team and we succeed as a team. We handle inbound inquiries that come from organizations across the globe and work to proactively generate conversations with interesting companies and institutions. Join the seamless machine that’s generating and managing the company’s business pipeline and customer base.

Transcribers

Our transcribers are integral to the Verbit journey in making the world more accessible and inclusive. As a Verbit transcriber, you can work from anywhere at your convenience. Besides working on AI-generated drafts, you will also have the opportunity to meet fellow transcribers worldwide and receive constant guidance and support. Join the growing team of transcribers and become part of the vision to textualize the world’s audio.

Our values

Verbit’s people are our greatest superpower. We’re committed to hiring and supporting the growth of our super-powerful people. We’re focused, ambitious and we care deeply about our work and each other. We believe the future is ours to create. We start each day ready to work hard together and channel our passion into purpose.

Do good

We have a shared mission to ‘do good’ for the world and to make it an accessible, inclusive place for each and every person.

Win together

We share in each other’s wins and empower each other in a joint journey toward success.

Collaborate with intelligence

We believe that combining the power of humans and technology creates outcomes that are: responsible, precise and efficient at scale.
